## Homework

Working with **intertidal data**. Your goal is to make a plot where at least one axis is a **factor in a meaningful order**.

- Data files in the `data/` folder: `intertidal.csv` and `intertidal_latitude.csv` (plus a data dictionary)

- You may need to use string-cleaning skills (check out the **{janitor}** [package](https://sfirke.github.io/janitor/articles/janitor.html)) to tidy column names

- If you visualize by **tide height**, it must go Low → Mid → High on the plot

- If you visualize by **site**, it must go in order of **latitude** (N→S or S→N)

```{r}
#load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(forcats)
library(janitor) #for cleaning data
library(ggthemr)
```

```{r}
#import data
intertide <- read.csv(here("Week_09","Data","intertidaldata.csv"))
lat <- read.csv(here("Week_09", "Data", "intertidaldata_latitude.csv"))
```

### Cleaning Intertidal Data

```{r}
#filter data to only the scripps site and summarize the bare rock data
scripps <- intertide |> 
  clean_names() |>  #from janitor package
  filter(site=="Scripps") |> 
  group_by(quadrat) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_rock = mean(bare_rock))

glimpse(scripps) #looks like the quadrat data has to be cleaned :(

#clean up data
scripps1 <- scripps |> 
  mutate(clean_quadrat = recode(quadrat, "High  "="High", "Low ."="Low", "Mid " = "Middle", " High"="High", "Mid  1" ="Middle", " Low" = "Low", " Mid"="Middle", " Low  ."="Low", "Mid"="Middle")) #also edit mid to be middle for when I plot it

#resummarize now that itʻs clean
cleanscrip <- scripps1 |>  
  group_by(clean_quadrat) |> 
  summarize(
    meanrock=mean(mean_rock)
  ) 
  
#manually set the levels of the tidal height so it goes in an order that makes sense
cleanscrip$clean_quadrat <-  factor(c("Low","Middle","High"),
                           levels=c("Low", "Middle", "High"))

```

### Plotting the Bare Rock percent cover at Scripps

```{r}
#set plot theme
ggthemr("lilac") 

#plot showing the average percent cover of bare rock in quadrats at the scripps site only 
ggplot(cleanscrip, mapping = aes(x=clean_quadrat, y=meanrock)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title="Average Percent Cover of Bare Rock at Scripps", x="Tidal Height", y="Percent Cover (%)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,100)) 

ggsave(here("Week_09","Outputs","HWplot.png"))
```
